question: What is the primary objective of the hyperloop test track launched by IIT Madras and Indian Railways in 2025?

options.text: To revolutionise high-speed transportation and reduce travel time
To develop a new mode of transportation for goods
To test the feasibility of vacuum tube technology

solution:
The Correct answer is __**To revolutionise high-speed transportation and reduce travel time**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
